newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares back off highs in mixed market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares back off highs in mixed market.

text.p: Sweden's sharemarket eased on Wednesday, off the all-time high close it hit on Tuesday with most losses posted late in the day after New York opened weaker.
The Stockholm general index slipped 0.71 percent to 2,125.49 after shares worth 3.98 billion crowns changed hands.

The forestry sector was the worst performer, dropping 1.98 percent after losing ground on Wall Street. A gloomy outlook for the rest of the year by Sweden's forestry group Sodra added to the downbeat tone of the sector, brokers said.
MoDo closed 4.5 crowns lower at 183 crowns while Stora tumbled 3.5 to 87 crowns.
Brokers said there was movement away from cyclical stocks.
Rate-sensitive stocks performed well after a sharp fall in Swedish yields prompted by a cut in the National Debt Office's state borrowing forecast for calendar 1996.
The banking sector rose 0.66 percent. S-E-Banken rose 2.5 crowns to 58 while Handelsbanken dipped two to 164.5 crowns.
The market heavyweights dipped. Telecoms group Ericsson fell 1.5 to 173.5 crowns and Astra by 2.5 to 294.5 crowns.
